targets.review_note: At each integer time, keep the greatest total production rate achievable for each resource balance; a lower rate with the same balance is dominated. Purchases are instantaneous and reduce balance, so descending-balance relaxations exhaust every possible purchase sequence before the next harvest. Advance all states by one discrete harvest and stop at the first target-reaching time. Prune only globally dominated peon types with no lower price and no higher efficiency; cap production at the target because any such rate reaches it at the next harvest. Bind to the earlier original production checkpoint CP-922355d3cf724b42, where the complete task is already observed, instead of truncating the later25798-token sequence.

targets.review_note: Group all unordered paths including singleton vertices by their number of vertices. A heap-indexed complete binary tree splits into two complete subtrees whose sizes are determined exactly by the last level; memoized shape recursion combines depth counts and cross-root path counts without enumerating up to10^18 vertices. For a path of length L, summing its maximum over all m^L assignments gives m*m^L-sum(t^L,t=0..m-1); the n-L other vertices contribute m^(n-L). Accumulate path multiplicities modulo998244353. The same formula includes m=1 and n=1.
